Entry House of Black and White The House of Black and White is both a sanctuary and one of the most mysterious locations in Braavos. The poor may find a painless death in it, the rich may fear its invisible influence, and the maester can only piece together the truth from scattered rumors; its silence is more powerful than the threats of many castles Altars, relics, and prophecies can unite people and give a political claim the appearance of irrefutability.

Entry House of Black and White The House of Black and White is both a sanctuary and one of the most mysterious locations in Braavos. The poor may find a painless death in it, the rich may fear its invisible influence, and the maester can only piece together the truth from scattered rumors; its silence is more powerful than the threats of many castles Some people use it as a talisman, while others use it as the name of fear; the same prayer may make people draw their swords or put them down.

Entry House of Black and White The House of Black and White is both a sanctuary and one of the most mysterious locations in Braavos. The poor may find a painless death in it, the rich may fear its invisible influence, and the maester can only piece together the truth from scattered rumors; its silence is more powerful than the threats of many castles Whether the gods responded or not could not be proven by the account books, but how the rituals were held and who could interpret the omens actually determined the authority of the community.
